info.title: Arkhe x 0x Solana Swap Governed HTTP Gateway
info.description: Governed Rust HTTP gateway enforcing RFC 9421 Ed25519 0x verification, Rust MessageV0 + ALT policy evaluation, single-use signing boundary, MMR decision receipts, and on-chain confirmation reconciliation (dry-run only: zero real signatures, zero network broadcasts).
